name: Variation vs Budget Report
query: SELECT project as "Project:Link/Project:150", name as "Contract:Link/GE Contract:150", contract_amount as "Contract Amount:Currency:150", contingency_amount as "Contingency:Currency:150", (SELECT SUM(requested_amount) FROM `tabGE Variation Order` WHERE contract=`tabGE Contract`.name AND docstatus=1) as "Total Variations:Currency:150" FROM `tabGE Contract` WHERE docstatus=1
